newsitem.title: USA: Alamco restates results to reflect changes.
newsitem.headline: Alamco restates results to reflect changes.

text.p: Alamco Inc said on Friday that it restated its results of operations for the nine months and the five-years to reflect changes in accounting for stock options as a result of the employee tax reimbursement feature included in the option arrangements.
During the eight year period 1987 to 1994, the aggregate non-cash compensation expense charged or credited to income was $387,000 net, the company said.
For 1995, the net aggregate charged to income was $416,000 and an additional $917,000 in the first nine months of 1996.

Net income and earnings per share for the nine months ended September 30, 1996, were $1,563,000 or $0.32 per share as adjusted, compared to $2,481,000 or $0.51 per share as originally reported, Alamco said.
Net income and earnings per share for the year ended December 31, 1995 were $1,272,000 or $0.27 per share as adjusted, compared to $1,695,000 or $0.36 per share as originally reported.
